description: Szélessáv.net is the internet speed measurement portal of Hungary's National Media and Infocommunications Authority (NMHH). Pages read on 2026-09-29 show that users can run a speed test and that the authority publishes national, aggregated results from three measurement sources: drive-test cars measuring the mobile networks, software measurements made by users on any network, and NMHH hardware measurement boxes installed on fixed lines. Users can also view their own measurement history. The portal also covers mobile net neutrality and a hardware partner programme. Coverage: national, Hungary, fixed and mobile broadband by operator. Format and access: free interactive result views on szelessav.net; no bulk download was found on the pages read. Licence: not stated (the site states all rights reserved). Caveats: the result views need JavaScript and were not read in full from the cloud; the earlier address szelessav.nmhh.hu no longer answers; crowd-sourced software tests depend on user equipment. Simulation uses: service performance baselines for telecom resilience studies and capacity planning of broadband networks. Related records: compare with NMHH's market reports (data-nmhh-mobile-and-fixed-market-reports) and ANCOM's Netograf internet quality data for Romania (data-ancom-netograf-internet-quality).
